# Coutto Sew / 纽扣缝纫

> An AI sewing app for projector cutting, pattern size calibration, A4 pattern assembly, printing, and pattern storage. Available on iPhone and iPad; Android is not publicly released.

## Product
- [Chinese homepage](https://coutto.app/): Features, downloads, and FAQ.
- [English homepage](https://coutto.app/en/): Features, downloads, and FAQ.

## Tutorials
- [Chinese tutorials](https://coutto.app/tutorials/): Guides for projector sewing and using the app.
- [English tutorials](https://coutto.app/en/tutorials/): Guides for projector sewing and using the app.
- [Chinese user guide](https://coutto.app/zh/2026/09/coutto-pattern-app-user-guide/): Calibration and projection steps.
- [English user guide](https://coutto.app/en/2026/09/coutto-pattern-app-user-guide/): Calibration and projection steps.
